rows.Bloom: Light pink. Mild fragrance. 25 to 30 petals. Full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered, spiral centers bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall, upright. Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 5' to 7' (150 to 215cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
